# Anasy-RSS-MHJoyBots-FUSE

> High-Performance Telegram Mirror, Leech & FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Engine

Anasy-RSS-MHJoyBots-FUSE is an advanced asynchronous Python Telegram mirror and leech bot that solves the critical double-storage bottleneck on VPS deployments. By utilizing Linux FUSE (`archivemount` in `readonly,nosave` mode), multi-gigabyte archives (`.zip`, `.tar`, `.7z`) are mounted directly into the virtual filesystem without physical decompression, reducing peak disk footprint by over 50%.

## Key Capabilities

- **FUSE Zero-Double-Storage Engine**: Dynamically mounts archive files on-the-fly via Linux VFS, eliminating the need to decompress archives to disk.
- **Interactive Inline ZIP Picker GUI**: Native Telegram button interface (`/leech <link> -e -s`) featuring multi-page pagination, file selection checkboxes, and size previews.
- **TDLib Multi-Session Concurrency Pool**: Bounded semaphore concurrency cluster distributing multi-part split uploads across multiple authenticated Telegram user accounts.
- **Dual Telegram Leech & Google Drive Backup**: Primary upload to Telegram channels with non-blocking asynchronous replication to Google Drive.
- **Smart WZML Media Captioning**: Real-time `ffprobe` stream metadata extraction for video resolution, duration, audio language tracks, and embedded subtitle streams.
- **Universal Multi-Engine Protocols**: Deep integration with `aria2c`, `qBittorrent` (with search plugins), `Sabnzbd` (Usenet / NZB), `JDownloader2`, and `yt-dlp`.

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MHJoy99/mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse.git
cd Anasy-RSS-MHJoyBots-FUSE
cp config_sample.py config.py
docker compose up -d --build
```
